output.question: Who is Cisco's CTO?
output.answer: Cisco's own newsroom executive pages list Tom Gillis as SVP and Chief Technology Officer. This is the company-wide CTO title, not a unit or regional one. His bio says he drives Cisco's vision for systems-level platform innovation. He rejoined Cisco in January 2023 to lead the Security Business Group, and by mid-2025 he was SVP and GM of infrastructure and security. I could not find a Cisco press release that gives the date he became CTO. Cisco also has CTOs for units and regions, such as Kunal Mukerjee (SVP and CTO, Splunk) and Chintan Patel (CTO, EMEA).

key_facts.fact: Tom Gillis is listed as SVP and Chief Technology Officer, Cisco, on Cisco's executive bios page.
key_facts.date: 2026-11-11 (page viewed; the page has no date)

key_facts.fact: Gillis's Cisco bio gives his title as SVP and Chief Technology Officer and says his role sets the direction for systems-level platform innovation across Cisco's full stack, from silicon to software.
key_facts.date: 2026-11-11 (page viewed; the page shows a 2026 copyright and no other date)

key_facts.fact: Kunal Mukerjee is listed as SVP and CTO, Splunk. That is a CTO for a subsidiary, not for Cisco as a whole.
Cisco appointed Chintan Patel as CTO for Europe, the Middle East and Africa. This is a regional role.

passages.quote: Tom Gillis: SVP and Chief Technology Officer
Tom Gillis — SVP and Chief Technology Officer, Cisco

caveats: I could not find a Cisco press release that says when Gillis became CTO. One aggregator, Zonebourse, gives a start date of 01/08/2026, but I did not check it against the original source.

Some third-party sites, such as Clay and older Cisco pages, name divisional CTOs as 'Cisco CTO', for example Matthew MacPherson (Wireless) and Roland Acra (Enterprise Networking). Those are not the company-wide role.
Gillis is not on Cisco's 12-person Executive Leadership Team. Cisco lists him among its senior leaders.
